details.summary: Hungarian-born American lawyer and second Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) 1973-1997
details.life: Was born 24 February 1919 in Budapest, Hungary and died 19 September 2004 in Geneva, Switzerland. He was the son of Árpád Bogsch, lawyer, and Emília Taborsky. On 11 April 1942 he married Paula Takáts, with whom he had one daughter and one son. After her death in 1987 he married Adèle Fankhauser, his former secretary, on 8 January 1994.
